mission.display_title: Obtain least squares slope and intercept
mission.mission_purpose: Today's Mission exists to turn the simple LM into least-squares estimates of slope and intercept — so estimation is a method, not a software button myth.
mission.tutor_intent: Today I will force the candidate to state what least squares minimises and how slope/intercept estimates arise — refuse button-only OLS.
mission.educational_intent: Produce method warrant for OLS slope and intercept in the simple case.
mission.learning_objective: Obtain and interpret least squares estimates of the slope and intercept parameters in a simple linear regression model.
mission.concept_focus: Minimise squared residuals → slope → intercept → refuse button-myth.
mission.prior_bridge: Yesterday you stated simple/multiple forms (4.1.2). Today estimates the simple case.
mission.why_now: 4.1.3 is the estimation hinge before software-heavy 4.1.4.
mission.expected_benefit: Study Progress for OLS estimates — not full residual diagnostics as primary.
success_criteria: Closed-book, state what least squares minimises.
Interpret slope and intercept estimates in context.
Refuse: 'OLS is whatever the software prints without a criterion'.
task_descriptions: Sketch residual → squared → minimise before CMP.
Knowledge Checks: minimise + interpret + refuse button-myth.

knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 4.1.3
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) What quantity does least squares minimise? (2) In words, what does the slope estimate mean for Y vs X?
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Minimises the sum of squared residuals. Slope: change in mean Y per unit X (holding the simple-model frame).
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 4.1.3
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. A student says 'least squares is just clicking Fit'. Refuse and restate the criterion OLS implements.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Refuse: clicking Fit is not the method. OLS chooses slope/intercept to minimise sum of squared residuals.
